items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'And this is Lee Freelander's apartment.'

ctx.x: Let's see, where are we recording? Apartment 4G. Okay, you got the thing? We're at apartment 4G, 241 Central Park West. The date is June 18, 1959. And this is Lee Freelander's apartment. We're looking at some of his pictures. And this is just a test on the machine. So, Lee, you say something, huh?
